'''Noshy Heer''' was a vagrant forced to scrounge for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] after gambling all his money away in the [[Relatta system/Legends|Relatta system]]. Trying to return home to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where the rest of his money was stored, the planet was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] before he made it. Heer was therefore forced to spend the rest of his life traveling the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] by stowing aboard different [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
